title: Physical-target leads for unresolved Epoch reference sites
semantics: Lead-only candidates are research inputs, not canonical coordinates. Conflicting secondary coordinates remain unpromoted until an authoritative parcel or equivalent defensible target is established.

official_project_context.finding: OpenAI publicly describes a 1GW Stargate UAE compute cluster in Abu Dhabi; the retained evidence does not establish a defensible facility parcel coordinate.

targets.conflict_note: Secondary coordinate leads are inconsistent and are not treated as authoritative facility parcels; an independent directory states the exact location is not public.
blocking_evidence: Authoritative parcel/site boundary or equivalent project-specific geospatial record
Independent primary or independently corroborated record tying the address to the physical Epoch target
A defensible acquisition target before site-specific physical interpretation is promoted
targets.promotion_rule: Promote to RESOLVED only when a primary or independently corroborated project-specific source establishes the physical target.

public_area_leads.finding: Two people familiar with planning confirmed the complex's location near Al Dhafra Air Base. Reuters reports this location had not previously been publicly known.

current_plan_context.finding: The original single-site 5 GW Abu Dhabi campus is being reconsidered as a distributed network across the UAE; first-phase construction is reported to continue with modifications. The reporting does not publish a parcel boundary or canonical coordinate.
